verses.1: In those days there was a famine in the land. A man from the town of Bethlehem in Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and two sons.
verses.2: This man's name was Elimelech; his wife's name was Naomi; and his two sons' names were Mahlon and Chilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah, and they went to the country of Moab and lived there as foreigners.
verses.3: Then Naomi's husband Elimelech died, and she was left with her two sons.
verses.4: His sons took two wives from the Moabites, one named Orpah and the other named Naomi.
verses.5: Then Mahlon and Chilion both died, and Naomi was left with her husband and her two sons.
verses.6: Naomi decided to return to the land of Moab, for she had heard there that Jehovah had visited his people to give them food.
verses.7: and his two sisters accompanied him. They left the place where he was staying and were on their way back to the land of Judah.
verses.8: Then Naomi said to her daughters - in - law, "Go back each to her mother's house. Show kindness to the Lord, as you have shown kindness to the dead and to me".
verses.9: May the Lord bless each of you in the house of her husband. " Then she kissed them and wept.
verses.10: "No, " they said", but we will go back with you to your people".
verses.11: "Return, my daughters, " said Naomi", why should you come with me? Am I to bear another son, so that he may be your husband?
verses.12: Go your way, my daughters. I am too old to marry again. I have no hope of ever having children.
verses.13: Do you want me to wait until my children grow up? Do you want me to wait until my children grow up? Do you want me to wait until you get married? Do you want me to wait until you get married? Do you want me to wait until you get married? Do you want me to wait until you get married? Do you want me to wait until you get married? Do you want me to wait until you get married?
verses.14: Then Orpah went out and kissed her mother - in - law, weeping. But Ruth stood by her mother - in - law.
verses.15: Then Naomi said, "Look, your sister - in - law is going back to her people and to her gods. Go back, you also, with her".
verses.16: But Ruth said, "Do not plead with me to leave you or to forsake you; for where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
verses.17: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord do this to me and more if anything besides death separates me from you".
verses.18: Naomi saw that Ruth was willing to go with her, and she stopped trying to persuade her.
verses.19: So the two of them went on until they came to Bethlehem. As soon as they entered the town, the whole town shouted about them. "Is this Naomi? " the women asked.
verses.20: "Do not call me Naomi, " she said", but call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.21: I went out joyful, but the Lord has brought me back joyful. Why do you call me Naomi, when the Lord, the Almighty, has set me on trial?
verses.22: So Naomi went back, accompanied by her sister Ruth the Moabitess. And they came to Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.
